champion.tips: JHIN TIPS AND TRICKS Keep a constant eye on how much ammo you have left when trying to fight. Do not commit to an extended trade when you have little to no ammo as you’ll be left reloading in the fight. Try and consume your 4th shot on an enemy champion as the fourth shot deals tons of damage. When casting your Ultimate R , make sure you’re in a safe position where the enemy cannot CC you or kill you while you’re standing still.
champion.builds: THE BEST JHIN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jhin Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Fleet Footwork as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Celerity and Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build The Collector as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Infinity Edge. For your last 3 items, you should build Rapid Firecannon, Lord Dominik's Regards and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 51.9% winrate over 51 158 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Taste of Blood, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Coup de Grace with Presence of Mind in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are The Collector as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Infinity Edge as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rapid Firecannon, Lord Dominik's Regards and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 51.4% win rate across 13 632 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Jhin Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Taste of Blood, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Coup de Grace with Presence of Mind as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Hubris as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and The Collector as third item. The last 3 options are Infinity Edge, Rapid Firecannon and Lord Dominik's Regards. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.7% win rate over 2 292 matches played. Situational Jhin Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jhin build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jhin runes page.
